evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies transaction creation validation in src/wallet/spend.cpp.
rationale: Prevents integer overflow and node assertion aborts in CreateTransactionInternal when invalid recipient amounts exceeding MAX_MONEY are supplied. While it fixes a node crash demonstrated via fundrawtransaction ('Assertion failed: (!m_selected_inputs.empty()), function RecalculateWaste'), the bug requires an RPC caller to supply amounts exceeding 21 million BTC, making it a valuable sanity check rather than a release-blocking fund-safety issue.
